source: NAIC Model Laws, Regulations, Guidelines and Other Resources — Long-Term Care Insurance Regulation Provisions (chart HS-15), Spring 2024; each state block carries its own citations
verifiedAgainstPrimarySource: 2026-09-11 — every inflation-offer row below was read from the chart and quoted rather than paraphrased. content.naic.org answers 403 to this repository's fetch tool, so the chart is recorded in scripts/refdata/blockedSources.ts with its manual step; David saved it from a browser and it is now archived at refdata-snapshots/2026/naic-ltc-regulation-provisions/ with its hash and a record saying a person supplied it, which makes the next review a diff rather than a re-reading of every state. Where the PDF renders small capitals or opens a kerning gap, the citation is given as the document reads rather than as the text extractor returns it. COLORADO CORRECTED: its citation previously read 3 CCR 702-4:4-4-4, which composed the state's Cite line with the row's own reference; the chart gives Reg. 4-4-4 on that row and that is what now stands. NO MEDICAID OR PARTNERSHIP BLOCK IS CURATED: those figures live in each state's own Medicaid manual and insurance-department pages, the two secondary lists consulted on 2026-09-09 disagreed about several states' partnership status, and the aggregator that carries a full asset-limit table forbids commercial reuse. A block absent here is a block nobody has read, which resolveLtcStateRules reports as uncurated rather than filling in.
